stories.title: US judge blocks Trump’s plan to renovate historic DC golf course
stories.summary: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.
stories.detail: Order by judge Ana Reyes is the latest instance of the federal judiciary pushing back against Trump’s efforts to redesign the nation’s capital A federal judge has ordered a temporary suspension of any work at a historic Washington public golf course, in the latest setback for US president Donald Trump’s plan to turn it ⁠into a championship-level course. In a 30-page decision, US district judge Ana Reyes temporarily blocked the federal government from moving forward with a plan that would have closed East Potomac Park on Sunday.

details.summary: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.
It is the latest development in a months-long challenge to the US president's plans for East Potomac Golf Links.

stories.title: Canada-U.S. trade deal must include viable auto sector, Carney says
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney says trade talks with the U.S. are making progress, but Ottawa won't accept a deal that doesn't allow for a viable auto sector.
stories.detail: Prime Minister Mark Carney was speaking at a news conference, three months after Canada pulled out of trade talks with the U.S., saying there had been last-minute demands from Washington that included a hit to Canada's auto sector.

stories.title: New Mexico wanted free childcare for all. This is what's worked — and what hasn't
stories.summary: A year ago in November, New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to every eligible family, regardless of income.

stories.title: Midterm voters ended the long-running GOP dominance in state legislatures
stories.summary: In several states, Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and they weakened GOP dominance in others. Issues on the agenda: More access to health care, new limits on school vouchers.

stories.title: UK government to consider changing age of consent after allegations against Russell Brand
